name: space.bjj/bjj-space
title: bjj.space
description: BJJ gyms, timetables, open mats, competitions, camps, seminars and athletes worldwide.

tools.name: find_gyms
tools.description: Find Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu gyms near a place, in a country, by name or by team, with drop-in, free-trial and monthly-price filters. Nearest first when `near` is given. Thin facts (prices, drop-in, trials) come with `coverage`: a gym without one is unknown, not 'no'. For class times use find_classes; for one gym's timetable, prices and coaches use get_gym.

near.description: A place the user named ("Lisbon", "Austin, TX", "Kraków, Poland") or "lat,lng". A country or US state searches the whole area. Ask the user rather than guessing their location.

radius_km.description: Search radius around `near` in km. Defaults to the city's own size (10-40 km).

country.description: Limit to a country by name, e.g. "Portugal".

query.description: Part of the gym's name, e.g. "gracie barra".

drop_in.description: Only gyms that list a drop-in price.

free_trial.description: Only gyms that list a free trial.

max_monthly_price_usd.description: Only gyms listing a monthly price at or under this, in USD.

sort.description: Default: distance when `near` is a city or point, else recommended.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; repeat the same arguments with it.

detail.description: brief (default) or full: more facts per result, fewer results per page.

tools.name: find_classes
tools.description: Find classes on gyms' weekly timetables near a place: open mats, no-gi, kids, fundamentals, competition training, by day (a weekday, today, tonight, tomorrow or a date), time window, gi/no-gi and level. Times are the gym's local wall clock, labelled with its timezone. Timetables are what gyms publish weekly: for one-off cancellations this week check get_gym with sections [changes].

near.description: A place the user named ("Lisbon", "Austin, TX", "Kraków, Poland") or "lat,lng". A country or US state searches the whole area. Ask the user rather than guessing their location.

radius_km.description: Search radius around `near` in km. Defaults to the city's own size (10-40 km).

country.description: Limit to a country by name, e.g. "Portugal".

day.description: monday..sunday, today, tonight (today from 17:00), tomorrow, or YYYY-MM-DD.

days.description: Several weekdays at once, e.g. ["tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday"] for a trip. Use instead of `day`.

types.description: Class types. Default: adult BJJ (bjj, nogi, fundamentals, advanced, open_mat, competition_training). Kids: kids_bjj.

gi.description: gi or nogi. Classes with no stated kit are kept.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; repeat the same arguments with it.

detail.description: brief (default) or full: more facts per result, fewer results per page.

tools.name: get_gym
tools.description: One gym's facts (address, team, website, prices in local currency and USD, timezone) and, on request, its sections: timetable (the weekly classes, local times; filter with `day`), changes (cancelled or moved classes in the next 7 days), prices, coaches, programs, facilities, freshness (when bjj.space last checked it). Pass the id from find_gyms or the gym's bjj.space URL.

id.description: The record's id from a find tool.

url.description: Or the gym's bjj.space URL, path or slug.

sections.description: Sections to include. Default: none (facts only).

day.description: Only this weekday's classes in timetable.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: A city's BJJ overview for trip planning: gym count and the best-matching gyms, the open mats on each weekday, and the events coming up (optionally between two dates). One call instead of three; follow up with find_gyms, find_classes or find_events for more.

place.description: A city or town, e.g. "Lisbon" or "Austin, TX", or "lat,lng".

radius_km.description: Search radius around `near` in km. Defaults to the city's own size (10-40 km).

date_from.description: Events from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Find competitions, seminars and superfights near a place or in a country, between dates (default: from today), by name ("adcc 2026"), max price, series tier (1 = majors), open registration or live now. Seminars also filter by instructor and topic. Soonest first. For camps use find_camps; for one event's registration, prices, people, card or divisions use get_event; results: get_event_results.

near.description: A place the user named ("Lisbon", "Austin, TX", "Kraków, Poland") or "lat,lng". A country or US state searches the whole area. Ask the user rather than guessing their location.

radius_km.description: Search radius around `near` in km. Defaults to the city's own size (10-40 km).

country.description: Limit to a country by name, e.g. "Portugal".

kind.description: Event kinds. Default: all three. Camps are find_camps.

date_from.description: Events running on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today, or any date with `query`.

date_to.description: Events starting on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

query.description: Words of the event's name, e.g. "adcc 2026", "pans".

max_price_usd.description: Only events listing a top price at or under this, in USD.

weekend.description: This weekend only: the coming Saturday and Sunday. Use instead of dates for "this weekend".

registration_open.description: Only events whose registration is open today.

instructor.description: Seminars only: part of an instructor's name.

series_tier.description: Series tier: 1 = majors (ADCC, IBJJF Worlds), 2 = big regionals, 3 = the rest.

live.description: Only events live on bjj.space right now (bouts on the mats, brackets running).

sort.description: Default: soonest; relevance with `query`; nearest needs `near`.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; repeat the same arguments with it.

detail.description: brief (default) or full: more facts per result, fewer results per page.

tools.name: find_camps
tools.description: Find BJJ training camps by destination region, country or place, month or dates (default: upcoming), theme (beach, surf, women's...), level, gi focus, intensity, what is included, language, kids/family/solo, max price, length in days and instructor. Soonest first. For one camp's details (included, training split, good to know, people) use get_event; competitions and seminars are find_events.

near.description: A place the user named ("Lisbon", "Austin, TX", "Kraków, Poland") or "lat,lng". A country or US state searches the whole area. Ask the user rather than guessing their location.

radius_km.description: Search radius around `near` in km. Defaults to the city's own size (10-40 km).

country.description: Limit to a country by name, e.g. "Portugal".

query.description: Words of the camp's name or place.

month.description: Camps starting in this month, YYYY-MM.

date_from.description: Camps starting on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_to.description: Camps starting on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

destination.description: Region slugs (any of): europe, north-america, south-america, central-america-caribbean, asia, southeast-asia, middle-east, africa, oceania. For one country use `country`.

theme.description: Theme slugs (any of), e.g. beach, surf, womens, yoga-retreat, luxury, mountains.

skill_level.description: Also matches all-levels camps and camps that state no level.

gi_focus.description: Also matches camps doing both and camps that state neither.

primary_goal.description: The camp's main goal, as its organiser answered.

stated_only.description: With skill_level or gi_focus: only camps whose organiser stated it (default also includes camps that do not say).

included.description: Every item listed must be in the price.

max_price_usd.description: Camps with a listed price at or under this, in USD.

sort.description: Default: soonest (bookable first within a month); nearest needs `near`.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; repeat the same arguments with it.

detail.description: brief (default) or full: more facts per result, fewer results per page.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One competition, camp, seminar or superfight: dates, place, organiser, series, price, registration link and whether it is open, plus on request: registration (all listed dates), prices (ticket types), people (instructors, headliners, competitors), camp (included, training, good to know), card (a superfight's bouts), divisions (this event's, else the series' last edition's). Pass the id from find_events or find_camps, or the URL. Who won: get_event_results.

id.description: The record's id from a find tool.

url.description: Or the event's bjj.space URL, path or slug.

division_filter.description: Only division labels holding every word, e.g. "master 3 brown".

sections.description: Sections to include. Default: none (facts only).

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: One event series (a league, championship or tour, e.g. IBJJF World Championship, ADCC Trials): organiser, tier (1 = major), ruleset, website, edition count, upcoming editions, past editions (newest first, paged with cursor) and the divisions its last past edition ran. Pass an id, URL or slug. For one edition use get_event; to find events by place or date use find_events.

id.description: The series id (find_events and get_event return it under series).

url.description: Or its bjj.space URL (/events/series/...), path or slug.

division_filter.description: Only division labels holding every word, e.g. "master 3 brown".

cursor.description: past_next_cursor from the previous answer: the next page of past editions.

tools.name: find_people
tools.description: Find athletes and instructors by name, belt, nationality, team or verified status. Rows carry belt, nationality, team, a W-L record and medal counts. Names are matched by search and returned as candidates: confirm the right person before using their id. For one person's results, titles and lineage use get_person; for meetings between two people use compare_people.

query.description: A name or part of one, e.g. "gordon ryan".

team.description: A team/affiliation name, e.g. "Checkmat": people on its roster or at one of its gyms now.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; repeat the same arguments with it.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: One person's facts (belt, nationality, teams represented) and, on request: record (W-L-D, medals), results (newest first, 20 per page: event, date, division, outcome, opponent, method), titles (ADCC, IBJJF Worlds, Pans, Europeans), lineage, gyms, socials. Pass the id from find_people or the person's bjj.space URL; for a name call find_people first. For two people's meetings use compare_people.

id.description: The record's id from a find tool.

url.description: Or the person's bjj.space URL, path or slug.

results_offset.description: Skip this many results (newest first): the next page of `results`.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: One team (affiliation, e.g. Checkmat, Alliance): gym count, the countries it has gyms in, and on request its gyms (filter with `country`, 25 per page) and roster (listed athletes and coaches with their years). For gyms of a team near a place use find_gyms with `team`; for its athletes by belt or nationality use find_people with `team`.

id.description: The record's id from a find tool.

url.description: Or the team's bjj.space URL, path or slug ("checkmat").

country.description: Only the team's gyms in this country, e.g. "Germany".

gyms_offset.description: Skip this many gyms: the next page.

tools.name: get_event_results
tools.description: Results of one competition or superfight card: champions per division (or the card's bouts and winners), divisions with medallists (25 per page), one division's bracket (`division`), team medals, what is live now, and one athlete's path (`athlete`: a person id; answers "when does X fight"). Pass the event id or URL from find_events or get_event. For a person's career use get_person.

id.description: The record's id from a find tool.

url.description: Or the event's bjj.space URL, path or slug.

sections.description: Default: champions, or only the division/athlete asked for; live is added while the event runs.

division.description: A division id or label from the divisions section: its bouts in order.

athlete.description: A person id (from find_people): that athlete's bouts and next bout here.

division_filter.description: Only divisions whose label holds every word, e.g. "master 3 brown" or "female no-gi".

divisions_offset.description: Skip this many divisions: the next page.

bouts_offset.description: Skip this many bouts of a fight card or a division (32 per page, final first).

tools.name: compare_people
tools.description: Head-to-head between two athletes: every meeting bjj.space holds (date, event, division, outcome from person_a's side, method) and the tally. Takes ids or bjj.space URLs only: for a name, call find_people first and confirm the person. It covers only matches bjj.space holds, not a full career; for one person's record use get_person.

person_a.description: A person's id from find_people, or their bjj.space URL. Not a name.

person_b.description: A person's id from find_people, or their bjj.space URL. Not a name.

tools.name: find_content
tools.description: Find BJJ media and products on bjj.space: podcast episodes, videos, news articles, bjj.space's own guides (rules, belts, etiquette), or marketplace products (instructionals, gis, gear). Pick one `kind`; add `query` for a topic or a name ("gordon ryan", "leg locks"); without it the newest come first. For gyms, events or athletes use find_gyms, find_events or find_people; for a name of unknown type use search.

kind.description: podcast, video, article, guide (bjj.space's own explainers) or product (marketplace).

query.description: Words to match in the title, summary, show or vendor.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; repeat the same arguments with it.

detail.description: brief (default) or full: more facts per result, fewer results per page.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Free-text search across everything on bjj.space (gyms, cities, competitions, camps, seminars, athletes, organisations, media, products) by name, for when the type is unknown or a typed tool found nothing. Each hit gives its type, url and the tool that reads it. For filtered questions (near a place, by date, drop-in, belt) use the typed find_* tools instead.

query.description: A name or a few words, e.g. "atos jiu-jitsu".

type.description: Narrow to one type (up to 10 hits instead of 5 per type).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; repeat the same arguments with it.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one public bjj.space page as Markdown (YAML front matter with its facts, then the details), for pages no typed tool covers: organisations, the homepage, or a URL the user pasted. Long pages are cut with a note. For gyms, events, athletes, teams, series and cities the typed get_* tools answer in fewer bytes and with structure.

url.description: A bjj.space URL or path, e.g. "/orgs/123" or "https://bjj.space/people/gordon-ryan".
